metadata.title: sivak.ai — AI and automation for your business
metadata.description: We bring AI into everyday business work. Agents and automation that take over routine computer work and pay for themselves fast.

hero.tagline: AI and automation for your business
hero.lead: We deploy AI agents that take over routine computer work, so your team can focus on what only people can do.

items.title: AI agents on your team
items.text: They handle customer requests, check documents and test software. The agent prepares, a person decides.

items.title: Process automation
items.text: We connect systems that don't talk to each other. No more retyping data from one window into another.

items.title: Robots for legacy software
items.text: They operate programs with no API — Helios, DOS applications and in-house systems nobody wants to rewrite.

approach.label: How we work

items.title: Fast payback
items.text: We start where AI saves the most hours.

items.title: Under control
items.text: Agents get only the permissions they need, and every step is recorded.

items.title: Measurable results
items.text: You see how much work the agent did and what it saved you.

approach.case: For a software company, we run agents that investigate customer tickets and test new releases in a real browser.

contact.heading: Show us what slows you down.
contact.text: In the first meeting we go through your processes and tell you where AI pays off.
